The '''Rimesea''' was a deep [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]]. A major harbor in [[Vossport/Legends|Vossport]] was the hub of maritime commerce, sending [[wind-ship]]s out to distant lands and ports such as [[Fume/Legends|Fume]].<ref name="NoP" />
